categories.main_business_segments: Rengo Co., Ltd. operates five main business segments: Paperboard and Paper Processing (including paperboard, corrugated board, corrugated boxes, and kraft pulp), Flexible Packaging, Heavy Packaging, Overseas Business (covering all packaging types and nonwovens), and Other Businesses (such as nonwovens, packaging machinery, logistics, insurance, leasing, and real estate). The company is a comprehensive packaging provider with a strong presence in both domestic and international markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages integrated production from raw paper to finished corrugated boxes, advanced adhesive and lamination technologies, digital printing, and proprietary packaging machinery. R&D focuses on environmentally friendly materials (e.g., cellulose-based products, biodegradable films), high-performance films for flexible packaging, and automation/DX for productivity and quality improvement. The group also develops unique functional materials and packaging automation systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Rengo serves a broad range of industries, with a particular focus on the food and beverage sector, processed foods, logistics, consumer goods, and industrial products. Its customer base includes manufacturers, retailers, and logistics companies, both in Japan and globally. No single customer accounts for more than 10% of sales, reflecting a diversified client portfolio.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Japan but has significant overseas operations in Asia (notably China, Southeast Asia, and India), Europe, and North America. Overseas sales account for approximately 22% of total revenue, and the company continues to expand its global footprint, especially in growth markets such as India and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Rengo is positioned midstream to downstream in the supply chain, manufacturing packaging materials and finished packaging products that are supplied to a wide range of end-user industries. The company also supplies raw materials internally and to group companies, and provides logistics and packaging machinery solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening core packaging businesses, expanding overseas operations, and driving sustainability through eco-friendly packaging solutions. R&D is focused on reducing environmental impact (e.g., GHG reduction, circular economy), developing new cellulose-based and biodegradable materials, digital transformation (DX), and automation. The company also emphasizes human capital development and diversity as part of its long-term vision.
categories.revenue_model: Rengo generates revenue primarily through the sale of packaging products (paperboard, corrugated boxes, flexible and heavy packaging), as well as related services such as logistics, machinery, and real estate. Revenue is recognized at the point of delivery to customers, with some recurring sales from long-term supply relationships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Rengo is a leading company in the Japanese packaging industry and a global top-tier player in corrugated packaging. Major competitors include Oji Holdings, Nippon Paper Industries, and other large packaging and paper companies. Rengo differentiates itself through integrated production, broad product range, and strong R&D in sustainable packaging.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, Rengo reported consolidated net sales of 993.3 billion yen, with 25,011 employees. The company has shown steady revenue growth over the past five years, driven by M&A and overseas expansion, though profit margins have fluctuated due to cost pressures. The medium-term vision targets 1.2 trillion yen in sales and 72 billion yen in recurring profit by FY2030.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Rengo emphasizes its ability to provide comprehensive, sustainable packaging solutions tailored to diverse customer needs, leveraging integrated production, advanced technology, and a global network. The company differentiates itself through eco-friendly product development, high quality, customer-oriented service, and innovation in both materials and packaging systems.
